title: Comparison of Breast Acoustic CT and Automated Breast Ultrasound in Women With Unilateral Untreated Breast Cancer
official: Comparison of the Diagnostic Accuracy of Bilateral Whole Breast Ultrasound Using QT Imaging and Invenia Automated Breast Ultrasound (ABUS) [GE Healthcare] in Women With Unilateral Untreated Current Breast Cancer.
summary: This study addresses an unmet need to improve the diagnostic accuracy of: 1. supplemental breast cancer screening with whole breast US and 2. the evaluation of disease extent in women with newly diagnosed breast cancer.

interventions.name: QT Scanner: Quantitative Transmission Ultrasound Breast Imaging System
ABUS: Invenia™ ABUS, Invenia Automated Breast Ultrasound System, ABUS, GE ABUS

criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

1. Unilateral untreated breast cancer evaluated by breast MRI
2. Participants' age range ≥18 years old
3. Ability to understand and the willingness to provide written informed consent.
4. Female gender
5. Dense Breast composition
6. Breast MRI available for reference comparison
7. Able to undergo QT and ABUS imaging prior to definitive surgery or neoadjuvant therapy.

Exclusion Criteria:

1. Prior mastectomy
2. Bilateral breast cancer
3. Concurrent use of investigational agents
4. Active breast infection, open wound, or skin condition involving the breast that would interfere with imaging.
5. Breast size or body habitus incompatible with QT or ABUS image acquisition. i. Breasts with cup size A through DDD. Up to 400lbs of patient weight is supported.
6. Non-dense breast composition
7. Pregnant
8. Breast feeding
9. Receipt of neoadjuvant chemotherapy, endocrine therapy, or radiation therapy before QT/ABUS imaging
